Touches cli/wuwei/gh.py (pr: status target_url, the review-workflow read), cli/wuwei/evidence.py (ci_gaps), tests/test_evidence.py, docs/design.md section 6 and docs/site/concepts/evidence.md. Outside: CODEOWNERS and required reviews (#917), a config key. Lines come out of evidence.py and gh.py (evidence.py line 214 re-imports datetime inside budget, -1), never from guards.py or setup.py.
acceptance: given completed check runs and a pending commit status from a workflow the repository runs on pull_request_review, when evidence reads the PR, then it reports 'waiting on review: <context>' as actionable and no 'CI running'
given that status failing while a change request stands, when evidence reads the PR, then it reports 'change request outstanding: <context>' and no 'CI failing'
given a failing status from an ordinary CI workflow, when evidence reads the PR, then it reports 'CI failing: <context>' as today
given a head with no commit statuses, when evidence reads the PR, then no workflow-runs call is made
given the workflow-runs read fails, when evidence reads the PR, then the status stays CI (never a pass)
given either review gap, when the merge door runs with or without --auto, then it refuses
given the change, when the suite runs, then config still has five keys and the runtime size test passes at 3,000 lines or fewer
